title: GLB Creature Riding Vehicle with IK Mount Attachment
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) and GLTFLoader that implements an interactive scene where a 'SunglassesKhronos.glb' model (acting as the 'creature') is mounted on top of a 'ChronographWatch.glb' model (acting as the 'vehicle') using an Inverse Kinematics (IK) style mount-attachment system. The creature rides the vehicle as it moves through the scene.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 4, 8) looking at origin.
- Add a DirectionalLight at (5, 10, 7) intensity 1.5 and an AmbientLight intensity 0.4.
- Add a large flat GridHelper (20x20) as the ground plane at y=0.
- Load 'SunglassesKhronos.glb' as the creature. Scale it to roughly 2x so it is visible. This is the rider.
- Load 'ChronographWatch.glb' as the vehicle. Scale it to roughly 3x. This sits on the ground plane.
- Once both are loaded, position the vehicle at (0, 0.5, 0). Compute the vehicle's bounding box and place the creature on top of the vehicle's bounding box max Y, offset by a small amount (+0.3). This is the IK mount point.
- The creature must be parented to an empty THREE.Group called 'mountPoint' which is itself a child of the vehicle's root object. This ensures the creature follows the vehicle.

IK MOUNT SYSTEM:
- Maintain a 'mountOffset' vector {x:0, y: vehicleBBoxMaxY + 0.3, z: 0} relative to the vehicle center.
- The mount point group's local position equals mountOffset.
- Implement a 'bounce' animation: the creature oscillates vertically (sinusoidal, amplitude 0.15, frequency 2Hz) relative to the mount point to simulate riding bounce. This runs continuously when the vehicle is moving.
- Implement a 'lean' system: when the vehicle turns, the creature leans (rotates on Z axis) in the opposite direction of the turn, proportional to turn rate, clamped to [-0.3, 0.3] radians. When not turning, lean interpolates back to 0.

VEHICLE MOVEMENT:
- The vehicle moves on the XZ plane. Maintain speed (units/sec) and heading (radians).
- W/ArrowUp: accelerate by 0.1 per press, max speed 5.0
- S/ArrowDown: decelerate by 0.1 per press, min speed -2.0 (reverse)
- A/ArrowLeft: turn left (heading += 0.05 rad per press)
- D/ArrowRight: turn right (heading -= 0.05 rad per press)
- Space: emergency brake, set speed to 0 instantly.
- The vehicle's rotation.y must equal heading. Position updates each frame: x += sin(heading)*speed*dt, z += cos(heading)*speed*dt.
- Clamp vehicle position to [-9, 9] on both X and Z axes (arena bounds).

DETACH / REATTACH SYSTEM:
- Press 'E' to toggle detach/attach the creature from the vehicle.
- When detached: remove creature from mountPoint, add to scene at its current world position. The creature no longer follows the vehicle. Bounce and lean stop. The creature stays at its detached world position.
- When reattached (press E again): compute the current mountOffset on the vehicle, reparent creature back to mountPoint, reset local position to (0,0,0), resume bounce and lean.

UNDO / REDO SYSTEM:
- Every discrete action (each keypress of W/S/A/D/Space/E) records a snapshot: {vehiclePos:{x,y,z}, vehicleHeading, vehicleSpeed, creatureAttached:bool, creatureWorldPos:{x,y,z}}.
- Press 'Z' to undo (restore previous snapshot). Press 'Y' to redo.
- Maintain a history array (max 100 entries) and a historyIndex pointer.
- On undo/redo, restore vehicle position, heading, speed, and creature attachment state exactly.

HUD:
- Add a DOM overlay div id='hud' at top-left showing:
  - Speed: (current speed, 2 decimal places)
  - Heading: (in degrees, 1 decimal place)
  - Attached: (true/false)
  - Bounce: (current bounce offset, 3 decimal places)
  - Lean: (current lean radians, 3 decimal places)
  - History: (historyIndex / history.length)
- Add a button id='btn-reset' that resets everything to initial state (speed 0, heading 0, vehicle at origin, creature attached, history cleared).
- Add a button id='btn-detach-toggle' that does the same as pressing E.

STATE MANAGEMENT - window.__3D_STATE__ must expose:
- vehiclePos: {x, y, z} — vehicle world position
- vehicleHeading: number in radians
- vehicleSpeed: number
- creatureAttached: boolean
- creatureWorldPos: {x, y, z} — creature world position (whether attached or not)
- mountOffset: {x, y, z} — the IK mount offset vector
- bounceOffset: number — current sinusoidal bounce value
- leanAngle: number — current lean in radians
- historyIndex: number
- historyLength: number
- modelsLoaded: boolean — true once both GLBs loaded
- frameCount: number — incremented each animation frame
- lastAction: string — name of last action performed (e.g. 'accelerate','decelerate','turnLeft','turnRight','brake','detach','attach','undo','redo','reset')
- arenaMin: number (-9)
- arenaMax: number (9)
- dt: number — last frame delta time in seconds

Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Ensure all numerical values are never NaN or Infinity.
physics_constraints: Vehicle speed clamped to [-2.0, 5.0]. Vehicle position clamped to [-9, 9] on X and Z. Creature lean angle clamped to [-0.3, 0.3] radians. Bounce amplitude exactly 0.15 with frequency 2Hz. Mount offset Y must equal vehicle bounding box max Y + 0.3. All state values must be finite (no NaN/Infinity). Undo/redo must restore exact snapshot values. Detach must preserve world position of creature.
